keySentence: The boy loved the rabbit more than any toy.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The rabbit asked about being real. Love makes you real. The boy's love was strong. The boy loved the rabbit more than any toy.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The rabbit asked an old toy horse about becoming real. The horse said love is what makes a toy become real. The boy loved the rabbit more than any toy in the room. His love was gentle, warm, and grew stronger every day. The rabbit's fur became thin but the boy loved him still. Real magic was happening through the boy's true love.
facts.Word cards: wanted = 원했다 / real = 진짜의 / loved = 사랑받다 / truly = 진심으로 / mean = 의미하다
